scope.market_definition: The E-Pharmacy market involves the online sale of pharmaceutical products, including prescription and over-the-counter medications. Key participants include distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners operating globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of pharmaceutical products through various online platforms.
This layer focuses on companies that resell pharmaceutical products through e-commerce platforms.
This layer includes companies that provide integration services for e-pharmacy platforms.
This layer covers service providers that support e-pharmacy operations.
This layer includes various channel partners that facilitate e-pharmacy operations.

From childhood to adulthood through retirement, we're by your side through every stage of life, with
comprehensive services and coverage to meet your changing needs.

Oral health affects **all** your health, both physical and mental. 
* Dental coverage to fit a range of needs
* Plan options that bundle vision and hearing, too
* Coverage costs pennies a day
* Shop online anytime, 24/7/365

## Buying Medication Internationally

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading

## Unwavering Customer Commitment.

**We deliver in the most trying conditions, even when others don't.**

Our customers will tell you we've been the first vendor they've seen after a devastating hurricane
or a record snowstorm. We know you are relying on us to get your patients their prescriptions, and
our team will do what it takes to make that happen.

We take pride in our customer service. Each of our distribution centers is staffed with
representatives who work with you personally for fast resolutions. Whether it's IT support, or a
question about an order, your call is answered by a real person in your region who will work with
you until you have what you need. It's no coincidence that our customer satisfaction is rated the
highest in the industry.

[About Us][24]
[We deliver in the most trying conditions, even when others don't.]
When catastrophe strikes, our disaster response team is ready to deliver regular orders and
emergency supplies.
*Above: Smith Drug Company staff working with customers immediately following a hurricane.*

## Maximizing Success.

**We offer our customers all the tools, products and services they need to thrive in a highly
competitive environment.**

Our portal is your resource for orders, updates and industry news. We offer the most extensive
assortment of products available, including access to specialty medications, OTC, HME, brand and
generic pharmaceuticals.

Our merchandisers and pharmacy experts can maximize your success as a business owner. Whether its
guidance on setting up the front end or information on new offerings and products, our customers
regularly share feedback on what a difference our team has made to their store. Contact us today to
see what we can do for you.

[Expertise][25]
[We offer the most extensive assortment of products available.]
Our state of the art distribution centers send out thousands and thousands of orders every night –
with the highest degree of accuracy.

## Trust. Transparency.

**We are constantly looking for ways to better serve our customers and offer the best value in the
industry.**

**About the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy **


The National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) is the impartial professional organization
that supports its member regulatory state boards of pharmacy in creating uniform regulations to
protect public health. Founded in 1904, NABP aims to ensure the public’s health and safety through
its pharmacist competence assessment programs, license transfer and verification services, as well
as through pharmacy inspection and accreditation programs. For more information, please visit
[*www.nabp.pharmacy*][57].

## What is Rxworld.com's online pharmacy marketplace?

Rxworld.com is a comprehensive online pharmacy marketplace that connects over 5,000 licensed
independent pharmacies, hospitals, and VAWD-certified wholesalers. Our pharmacy marketplace platform
enables secure buying and selling of brand medications, generics, OTC products, and specialty
pharmaceuticals while ensuring full regulatory compliance.

## How do I join the pharmacy marketplace?

Registration for our online pharmacy marketplace is completely free with no long-term contracts
required. Simply provide your pharmacy or wholesale license information, complete our verification
process, and gain immediate access to our network of verified healthcare partners.

## Is RxWorld DSCSA-compliant? How are transaction records handled?

Yes. Every transaction on RxWorld automatically generates full DSCSA documentation — including
Transaction Information (TI), Transaction History (TH), and Transaction Statements (TS) as required
by the Drug Supply Chain Security Act. All trading partners are verified as Authorized Trading
Partners (ATPs) under FDA requirements. Serialized product identifier data is captured at the
package level for every Rx transaction, and records are retained for the FDA-required 6-year period.
You never need to manually request pedigree documents — it's all built into the platform.

## What types of pharmacies use RxWorld?

RxWorld serves independent retail pharmacies, long-term care pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, and
compounding pharmacies across the United States. Whether you fill 50 scripts a day or 500, our
platform is designed to reduce your procurement costs, help you move overstock quickly, and ensure
every purchase is fully compliant.

## Can I sell my overstock medications through the online pharmacy marketplace?

Absolutely. Our pharmacy marketplace specializes in helping pharmacies quickly liquidate unexpired
overstock medications to a nationwide network of verified buyers, recovering costs while minimizing
pharmaceutical waste.

## What if I need hard-to-find or shortage medications?

Our pharmacy marketplace excels in sourcing critical shortage medications through our diverse
network of suppliers. Advanced search algorithms help locate specific products quickly, ensuring you
can meet patient needs without delay.

### Your age-by-age guide to annual physical exams

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

# Keep Your Pharmacy Accessible, Even After Hours

Transform your pharmacy with Charac’s innovative solutions to optimise operations, enhance patient
experience, and drive sustainable revenue. We are the fastest-growing pharmacy tech platform,
trusted by pharmacy owners investing in our product every day!

[ Book a Demo ][39]
[ Buy Now ][40]

experience, and drive sustainable revenue growth]

## Designed to Boost Revenue and Enhance Your Pharmacy Operations

Empowering pharmacies with advanced tools to attract patients, improve efficiency, and grow revenue.

## Attract and Retain Patients

Engage patients with NHS logins, giving them easy access to healthcare services through your
pharmacy.

## Improve Your Delivery Offering

Enhance your delivery process using our integrated delivery platform, offering a seamless and
efficient experience from your pharmacy to the patient’s doorstep.

## Drive Your Sustainable Revenue

Promote private and NHS services to generate consistent income and retain EPS nominations for your
pharmacy.

## Create Awareness of Your Pharmacy

Boost your pharmacy’s visibility with our comprehensive marketing support—only 13% of patients are
fully aware of available pharmacy services.

## Save Time & Improve Customer Service

Digitise workflows and free up your pharmacists’ time, allowing them to focus more on patient care.

## One Integrated Platform for All Your Pharmacy Needs

Our platform brings together all key pharmacy operations in one place to optimise your services.

### Delivery Management

Improve logistics and ensure timely deliveries with ease.

### Prescription Management

Simplify handling with accurate and efficient tracking.

### E-PGDs

Provide easy access to electronic PGDs for smoother operations, with one license per premises, not
per person.

### Consultation Management

Patients can easily book consultations online at any time, ensuring accessibility and convenience.

### E-commerce

Boost your sales with an integrated online store that’s easy to manage.

### Communication Tools

Engage your patients through chat functionality, send notifications, and broadcast messages to keep
them informed and connected.

### Data & Analytics

Use data-driven insights to improve your pharmacy's performance.

## Your Pharmacy Means:

Data Processor

We do **NOT** own your data. You do.
We do **NOT** own your customers. You do.

Fair Competition

We do **NOT** promote other pharmacies to your customers. Your patients remain with your pharmacy,
ensuring a trusted and loyal relationship.

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

## Reliable distribution
## Reliable innovation
## Reliable through 5 generations

how we can work together to grow your business.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### TOGETHER CREATING A BETTER FUTURE

HAPA is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization that is inspired by the life and legacy of Dr. Thomas
W. Patrick Sr. Doctor Thomas W. Patrick Sr (1872-1953) migrated from Haiti to the United States as a
child with his family in 1892. While in the U.S, he became a Pharmacist and a Doctor providing
healthcare education, medical services, and pharmaceutical knowledge to the Haitian community.

We, at HAPA, strive to continue Dr. Patrick’s legacy by providing much-needed services within both
the Haitian American community and in other communities where our expertise is also needed.

[ BECOME A MEMBER ][119]

### Our Mission

The Haitian American Pharmacist Association is deeply committed to advancing health and well-being.
We focus on three key areas: Community Enrichment, where we empower individuals through education;
Professional Empowerment, ensuring seamless integration of pharmaceutical care; and Unified
Advancement, uniting our community for a healthier future within a holistic healthcare framework.

### Our Vision

To emerge as a preeminent catalyst for health education and advocacy, with an unwavering commitment
to reaching marginalized communities, and forging critical alliances with healthcare providers,
institutions, and policy influencers.

### Our Values

HAPA stands steadfast on the pillars of Health Enhancement, Community Education, Pharmaceutical Care
Integration, and Unity.

##### Cassandra Esperant

Pharmacist

Cassandra Esperant is a pharmacist at the Aids Healthcare Foundation, specializing in prescribing
HIV prevention medications. She collaborates with a medical doctor through a CPA. She’s passionate
about addressing public health issues in communities facing disparities, aiming to empower them with
tools for better healthcare. In her free time, Cassandra consults and educates on HIV prevention and
public health. She’s active in the SPARK Board for Women’s Empowerment and the Chairwoman of the
Education Committee of the Haitian American Pharmacist Association. Her future goals include
focusing on HIV prevention in Black/Hispanic women and serving on the Presidential Advisory Council
on HIV/AIDS. Fun Fact: In high school, Cassandra confidently told her chemistry teacher she didn’t
need his class because she was going to law school.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

# Introducing MedleyMed :
# India's leading Digital Platform for Pharmacies and Telemedicine

MedleyMed harnesses the power of technology to orchestrate the complex healthcare value chain. We
are improving accessibility, reliability and affordability through efficient demand aggregation,
supply chain reengineering and analytics. As an innovative start-up led by the young thinkers and
doers from top institutes like IIMs and IITs, we operate at the cutting edge of technology and
innovation. We have a powerful competitive advantage because of our business model, platform quality
and strong implementation team.

# Telemedicine Platform

Healthcare advancements are getting a major boost using technology. Telemedicine is one way to help
millions in India meet their needs for quick and affordable doctor consultations. MedleyMed is
enabling consultations through its technology platform, which is robust and can be customised. In
the bargain, for the patient the travel time and associated costs are reduced as well as waiting
time at clinics. The Telemedicine platform uses simple, digital touch points at the pre, during and
post consultation stages, leading to engaging experience for patients .

solution for all the products and retailers to place orders to multiple distributors for their

# **Empowering Pharmacies to Thrive**

### **Your Success, Our Pledge**

See How Below

## What We Offer

#### Partnership

Above all else, we are committed to serving your business as a valued partner. Our experienced team
is ready to tailor a solution to your unique business needs.

#### Inventory

We carry an array of inventory, with the opportunity for you to create your own formulary of
products.

#### Competitive Pricing

Our unique pricing models will be sure to save you money, without affecting with your prime vendor
agreements.

#### Compliance

As a NABP and HDA accredited wholesaler in all 50 states, we guarantee our customers the highest
industry standards.

[[Drug Distributor]][33]
[ Create Account ][34]

## Who We Serve
* #### Retail Pharmacy
  
  Whether you are a stand-alone independent or a chain pharmacy, we take a tailored approach that
  focuses on your specific business needs. We will work closely with you to develop a lasting
  relationship that can tackle today’s challenges, and prepare you for those of the future.
* #### Long-Term Care Pharmacy
  
  We provide consistent product levels to streamline delivery. We provide unique approaches to
  product bundling, as well as your item specific needs. We help to expand your level of care,
  working with you to improve delivery and not complicating it. Additionally, we recognize the
  challenges automation can bring. Therefore, we work closely with automation vendors, as well as
  have multiple product sizes available, to meet your needs.
* #### Hospital Pharmacy
  
  In the ever-evolving landscape of healthcare, hospital pharmacies are constantly having to evolve
  in order to face new challenges as well as manage them. As a critical player in patient care, it
  can be tough to navigate the complex intersections where multiple factors demand immediate
  attention. Revenue cycle, Drug Shortages, Formulary Management New Regulations, Financial
  Recovery, and 340B must be part of the conversation. For our part we understand and help provide
  assistance where available.
* #### Government Contracting
  
  Our experience navigating the unique nature of government contracts allows us to partner with your
  team, or directly with the government, to meet your contract needs. We understand the major
  characteristics that distinguish government acquisitions from private sector contracts (e.g.,
  statutes, regulations, and policies) and we are eager to use our knowledge in this area to best
  serve our clients.
* #### Food, Drug, Mass (FDM) Pharmacy
  
  We are familiar with working with procurement departments and pride ourselves on being an
  extension of your team. We provide solutions to address multiple site deliveries and billing
  challenges. Standardizing practices for easy deployment is a central point of our efforts.
* #### Specialty Pharmacy
  
  We provide expertise and guidance in this relatively new and expanding market. Understanding the
  sourcing and delivery challenges, we provide alternatives and opportunities for your current
  needs. We are committed to keeping pace with this segment and providing opportunities to our
  partners.
* #### Veterinary Pharmacy
  
  Taking care of our fury friends comes with its own unique set of challenges. Product mix,
  availability, and regulations play an integral role in managing this segment. Managing these
  issues and informing our partners to manage their expectations is just part of our process.

All of these solutions and opportunities are available to our partners no matter what pharmacy
segment you relate to.

  relationship that can tackle today’s challenges, and prepare you for those of the future.
* #### Long-Term Care Pharmacy
  
  We provide consistent product levels to streamline delivery. We provide unique approaches to
  product bundling, as well as your item specific needs. We help to expand your level of care,
  working with you to improve delivery and not complicating it. Additionally, we recognize the
  challenges automation can bring. Therefore, we work closely with automation vendors, as well as
  have multiple product sizes available, to meet your needs.
* #### Hospital Pharmacy
  
  In the ever-evolving landscape of healthcare, hospital pharmacies are constantly having to evolve
  in order to face new challenges as well as manage them. As a critical player in patient care, it
  can be tough to navigate the complex intersections where multiple factors demand immediate
  attention. Revenue cycle, Drug Shortages, Formulary Management New Regulations, Financial
  Recovery, and 340B must be part of the conversation. For our part we understand and help provide
  assistance where available.
* #### Government Contracting
  
  Our experience navigating the unique nature of government contracts allows us to partner with your
  team, or directly with the government, to meet your contract needs. We understand the major
  characteristics that distinguish government acquisitions from private sector contracts (e.g.,
  statutes, regulations, and policies) and we are eager to use our knowledge in this area to best
  serve our clients.
* #### Food, Drug, Mass (FDM) Pharmacy
  
  We are familiar with working with procurement departments and pride ourselves on being an
  extension of your team. We provide solutions to address multiple site deliveries and billing
  challenges. Standardizing practices for easy deployment is a central point of our efforts.
* #### Specialty Pharmacy
  
  We provide expertise and guidance in this relatively new and expanding market. Understanding the
  sourcing and delivery challenges, we provide alternatives and opportunities for your current
  needs. We are committed to keeping pace with this segment and providing opportunities to our
  partners.
* #### Veterinary Pharmacy
  
  Taking care of our fury friends comes with its own unique set of challenges. Product mix,
  availability, and regulations play an integral role in managing this segment. Managing these
  issues and informing our partners to manage their expectations is just part of our process.

All of these solutions and opportunities are available to our partners no matter what pharmacy
segment you relate to.

## Message From Registrar

Dear Consumer/Service Provider,
The Board and Management of the Pharmacy Council seeks to transform the Council into a regulatory
center of excellence that works seamlessly to guarantee the highest levels of pharmaceutical care in
Ghana. To achieve this, we pledge to deliver on our mandate by implementing the following among
others to promote public health and safety.
* Deploy technological solutions to improve service delivery and revenue collection.
* Develop the capacity of staff
* Promote professional competence and career development for all practitioners.
* Enforce practice standards to promote patient health outcomes and safety.
* Increase access to medicines and pharmaceutical services while ensuring consumer safety.
* Optimize stakeholder collaboration for enhanced pharmaceutical care.

Every day our pharmaceutical service providers meets health needs in many different ways, and the
Council expects them to continue making their contributions to better health around the country.
Please join me in celebrating all pharmaceutical service providers, their achievements in supporting
communities to improve health outcomes in every part of Ghana. **Thank you for your support and
cooperation**.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

# WHO WE ARE

We are a nationally accredited, pharmaceutical wholesale distributor. Most importantly, we are your
expert and partner in the pharma industry. Our service-first mentality starts with our PRx staff. We
are not just “call center order takers,” but instead, experts in our products and how you do
business. This means that we are aware of the trends and changes in the industry and how they affect
your pharmacy, regardless if you are independent, national or otherwise. To us, it is not just about
selling more. It is about anticipating your needs, keeping you ahead of the industry changes, and
bringing value to your business.

[Learn More About Us][9]

[[Drug Distributor]][10]

# WE ARE NABP® ACCREDITED!

PRX Wholesale has earned Drug Distributor Accreditation by the National Association of Boards of
Pharmacy® (NABP®).

The National Association of Boards of Pharmacy® (NABP®) is an impartial professional organization
that supports the state boards of pharmacy in creating uniform regulations to protect public health.
Through its accreditation, license verification, and testing programs, NABP aims to ensure the
public health and safety.

# WE ARE PROUD HDA MEMBERS!

A Healthcare Distribution Alliance membership provides access to networking opportunities, research,
member-developed education and resources for the healthcare supply chain.

## PRODUCTS


From manufacturer to pharmacy, we offer a wide selection of products to support your pharmacy's
needs. View all of our wholesale pharmaceuticals from generics to brands, and everything in between.

[ Learn More][11]

## SHIPPING


Getting your products in a timely matter is critical to us. Please check out our shipping schedule
and process to make sure we can get products to your patients on-time.

[ Learn More][12]

## FAQ


Have a question? Check out our frequently asked questions and if you don't see what you need, please
feel free to ask us directly anytime.

[ Learn More][13]

# What Sets Us Apart

### **Free shipping**

Surprise costs can hurt your business, so we offer free shipping for all orders meeting our minimum
order requirements. That way you know your cost the minute you purchase and never have to second
guess.

### **EDI/API Integration**

Working with your distributor should be seamless, which is why we offer full EDI and API
integrations with the systems you already use. Whether you have a service or something custom, call
us and we can work to make things easy.


### **We buy direct from Manufacturers**

Never worry about grey market products. All of our purchases come directly from the manufacturers or
exclusive wholesalers, and we have the tracking information to prove it.

### **Recall Processes**

Information is critical for your business and the safety of your patients. That is why we have an
automatic recall process that ensures you are never shipped products on recall and notifies you if
you have recalled products you purchased from us in the past.

### **EASY ON-BOARDING & CREDIT APPROVAL PROCESSES**

Getting started is just a form fill away. Just fill out our simple application form and we can set
everything up and have your credit ready in no time.

### **PAYMENT METHODS & FLEXIBLE CREDIT TERMS**

No matter your method, we accept all payment forms – credit card, check, wire, ACH and more. We can
work with your team to set-up a credit process that works for your pharmacy.

### **Industry experience in all of the market**

We have been on all sides of this industry, so we can provide the best possible solutions. Our team
is always equipped with the background and knowledge to help guide you through the minefield of
issues that can arise.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## What is Rxworld.com's online pharmacy marketplace?

Rxworld.com is a comprehensive online pharmacy marketplace that connects over 5,000 licensed
independent pharmacies, hospitals, and VAWD-certified wholesalers. Our pharmacy marketplace platform
enables secure buying and selling of brand medications, generics, OTC products, and specialty
pharmaceuticals while ensuring full regulatory compliance.

## How do I join the pharmacy marketplace?

Registration for our online pharmacy marketplace is completely free with no long-term contracts
required. Simply provide your pharmacy or wholesale license information, complete our verification
process, and gain immediate access to our network of verified healthcare partners.

## Is RxWorld DSCSA-compliant? How are transaction records handled?

Yes. Every transaction on RxWorld automatically generates full DSCSA documentation — including
Transaction Information (TI), Transaction History (TH), and Transaction Statements (TS) as required
by the Drug Supply Chain Security Act. All trading partners are verified as Authorized Trading
Partners (ATPs) under FDA requirements. Serialized product identifier data is captured at the
package level for every Rx transaction, and records are retained for the FDA-required 6-year period.
You never need to manually request pedigree documents — it's all built into the platform.

## What types of pharmacies use RxWorld?

RxWorld serves independent retail pharmacies, long-term care pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, and
compounding pharmacies across the United States. Whether you fill 50 scripts a day or 500, our
platform is designed to reduce your procurement costs, help you move overstock quickly, and ensure
every purchase is fully compliant.

## Can I sell my overstock medications through the online pharmacy marketplace?

Absolutely. Our pharmacy marketplace specializes in helping pharmacies quickly liquidate unexpired
overstock medications to a nationwide network of verified buyers, recovering costs while minimizing
pharmaceutical waste.

## What if I need hard-to-find or shortage medications?

Our pharmacy marketplace excels in sourcing critical shortage medications through our diverse
network of suppliers. Advanced search algorithms help locate specific products quickly, ensuring you
can meet patient needs without delay.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## About Us

### We’re here to make your journey as a patient easier.


#### United/XCel-Rx is a full-service ePharmacy that provides the personal care and attention of a
#### corner pharmacy with the discretion and cost-savings of online care management.


#### Our goal is continuity of care. When you leave the doctor’s office, a telehealth appointment,
#### or a care facility, you should feel confident that your pharmacist understands your condition
#### and needs. We liaise with healthcare providers to simplify the prescription process for you.
#### We’ll also search for coupons to help save you money at every possible opportunity.
####  

[GET STARTED ][23]

## Our Services

Pharmacy Services - We work hand-in-hand with your healthcare professionals to provide you with your
therapeutically correct treatment plan at the lowest price possible.

Medication Access Program (MAP) -United/XCel-Rx pharmacy is dedicated to supporting business owners
to provide cost-effective medication to employees and reducing the overall cost of pharmacy
benefits.

340B - Our job is to help you maximize scarce financial resources as far as possible to serve as
many patients as possible. Together, we can do more!

Pet Prescriptions - We liaise with your veterinary clinic to process, fill, and deliver your
prescription so you can focus on what matters most: helping your pet get well.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### TOGETHER CREATING A BETTER FUTURE

HAPA is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization that is inspired by the life and legacy of Dr. Thomas
W. Patrick Sr. Doctor Thomas W. Patrick Sr (1872-1953) migrated from Haiti to the United States as a
child with his family in 1892. While in the U.S, he became a Pharmacist and a Doctor providing
healthcare education, medical services, and pharmaceutical knowledge to the Haitian community.

We, at HAPA, strive to continue Dr. Patrick’s legacy by providing much-needed services within both
the Haitian American community and in other communities where our expertise is also needed.

[ BECOME A MEMBER ][119]

### Our Mission

The Haitian American Pharmacist Association is deeply committed to advancing health and well-being.
We focus on three key areas: Community Enrichment, where we empower individuals through education;
Professional Empowerment, ensuring seamless integration of pharmaceutical care; and Unified
Advancement, uniting our community for a healthier future within a holistic healthcare framework.

### Our Vision

To emerge as a preeminent catalyst for health education and advocacy, with an unwavering commitment
to reaching marginalized communities, and forging critical alliances with healthcare providers,
institutions, and policy influencers.

### Our Values

HAPA stands steadfast on the pillars of Health Enhancement, Community Education, Pharmaceutical Care
Integration, and Unity.

##### Cassandra Esperant

Pharmacist

Cassandra Esperant is a pharmacist at the Aids Healthcare Foundation, specializing in prescribing
HIV prevention medications. She collaborates with a medical doctor through a CPA. She’s passionate
about addressing public health issues in communities facing disparities, aiming to empower them with
tools for better healthcare. In her free time, Cassandra consults and educates on HIV prevention and
public health. She’s active in the SPARK Board for Women’s Empowerment and the Chairwoman of the
Education Committee of the Haitian American Pharmacist Association. Her future goals include
focusing on HIV prevention in Black/Hispanic women and serving on the Presidential Advisory Council
on HIV/AIDS. Fun Fact: In high school, Cassandra confidently told her chemistry teacher she didn’t
need his class because she was going to law school.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

# Introducing MedleyMed :
# India's leading Digital Platform for Pharmacies and Telemedicine

MedleyMed harnesses the power of technology to orchestrate the complex healthcare value chain. We
are improving accessibility, reliability and affordability through efficient demand aggregation,
supply chain reengineering and analytics. As an innovative start-up led by the young thinkers and
doers from top institutes like IIMs and IITs, we operate at the cutting edge of technology and
innovation. We have a powerful competitive advantage because of our business model, platform quality
and strong implementation team.

# Telemedicine Platform

Healthcare advancements are getting a major boost using technology. Telemedicine is one way to help
millions in India meet their needs for quick and affordable doctor consultations. MedleyMed is
enabling consultations through its technology platform, which is robust and can be customised. In
the bargain, for the patient the travel time and associated costs are reduced as well as waiting
time at clinics. The Telemedicine platform uses simple, digital touch points at the pre, during and
post consultation stages, leading to engaging experience for patients .

# Pharmacy Platform

MedleyMed has enabled hundreds of Pharmacies across India to grow their business, using technology
and logistics. MedleyMed Biz is a B2B pharmaceutical supply chain platform. Our platform enables
pharmacies the ease of buying all their pharmacy and general items. In short, it is a one stop
solution for all the products and retailers to place orders to multiple distributors for their
pharmacy needs. We provide real time details on schemes, pricing and availability of medicines.

At MedleyMed, we believe that technology provides an important part of the solution. Leveraging a

outcomes, lowering costs, and matching supply and demand ensures that healthcare works for
everyone—for patients and providers. Our work is making the experience of buying medicines online
better.

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.
